line: Four AI stories from one week in a full on-air package: rundown, headline strap, price board, spec card.
line_cn: 一周四条 AI 新闻，一整套电视台包装：串联单、标题条、翻牌价格表、规格卡。

motion.cuts: camera-led cuts: slide or push-through on motion

camera.move: 120 BPM grid, beat 0 at the end of the sting (1
camera.expresses: 5 s). Every cut and wipe on a beat or half-beat.
sting 1.5 s; rundown 4–5 s; story shots 3–7 s; a map long take (6–12 s) as the bulletin's breath; a comparison stays until every item has been fully on screen ≥ 2.5 s.
5–1 s inside a shot (flip, count, stamp, tick, strap change, map light, line step). No frame flat for more than 1 s; a strong action within 0.5 s of every cut.
a weekly bulletin's items happen on different days; the date sits in the rundown row, the eyebrow line, the readout or the document.
what (the name or the number) → how big (the line, the bars, the price board) → who it hits or who said it (bars, documents, a quote) → the verdict stamp.

transitions: Every cut and wipe on a beat or half-beat.
a strong action within 0.5 s of every cut.
labels: Latin: Barlow Condensed 800 (numbers, names, the plate), 600 (secondary lines, quotes), 600 italic (the end-card English title).
Mono: IBM Plex Mono 500 for datelines, sources, axis labels, all caps with 1–4 px tracking.
All OFL, subset from Google Fonts by demo/tools/fonts.sh (the character list is read from main.js; delete fonts/.woff2 after a text change). No handwriting faces in this style.

native_moves.name: Sting becomes the bug
native_moves.does: the brand plate slams in, then flies to the corner and stays there for the whole bulletin; opening and programme are one object.

native_moves.name: Strap tab = category
native_moves.does: the strap's tab changes category (模型 MODELS, 市场 MARKETS, 监管 POLICY …) with a white flash when a new story starts; no separate item cards between stories.

native_moves.name: Rundown, then ticked off
native_moves.does: the same list opens and closes the bulletin; at the end each row gets its tick.

native_moves.name: Spec card
native_moves.does: a launch reduced to its proportions: the whole and the part on one scale, then what it runs on, joined by a bracket to the total.

native_moves.name: Strap that never leaves
native_moves.does: one strap group from the first story to the recap; words flip, the strap itself never exits mid-programme.

native_moves.name: Split-flap before/after
native_moves.does: old and new value on one board, each tile flipping from the old to the new.

native_moves.name: Breaking the threshold
native_moves.does: a line advances one period per step towards a dashed threshold; the music stops for one beat before the last step and the crossing gets the heaviest hit.

native_moves.name: Date in the eyebrow
native_moves.does: every graphic's eyebrow line carries source and date in mono caps, so a weekly round-up never blurs which day each item happened.

native_moves.name: City sends the letters
native_moves.does: on a map long take, documents fly out of the sending city to their addressees; one world→screen function keeps labels and documents attached through push and pan.

native_moves.name: Quote card + verdict stamp
native_moves.does: the official's own words in type, with name, occasion and date; an underline on the key word as the voice says it; one stamp.

score.note: news bed: pulse, strings, piano hook
